placeholders.<WSL_DEV_HOME>: home directory of the WSL account that ran training and evaluation
placeholders.<WSL_PROJECT_HOME>: home directory of a second WSL account on the same workstation
placeholders.<WINDOWS_WORKSPACE_SLUG>: the Windows project workspace path flattened into one directory name
placeholders.<WINDOWS_USER_SLUG>: the Windows user profile path flattened into one directory name
placeholders.<WORKSTATION>: host name of the training workstation

note: The original stays on the workstation (git-ignored, unchanged). The sanitized copy differs only by the placeholder replacements counted per file.
